html:
SMTO-EXE-0204 — The PDF action was stopped before it finished

GUID: 01fc90c2-8509-5a0b-b373-3ee7ed19eecf
Slug: pdf-operation-cancelled
Domain: EXE · Subsystem: pdf

What happened

  • The PDF action stopped, either because the task was stopped or because the same request had already been sent once. This attempt saved no new file, but the earlier one might have.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Open Artifacts from this run, and any folder you asked SMTO to save into, and look for the new PDF or images. If the same request was already sent once, that earlier attempt may have saved the file.
  2. If the file is there and looks right, use it and don't ask again. Asking again would make a second copy or fail because the name is already taken.
  3. If nothing was saved, send SMTO a new message asking for the PDF action again. A new message creates a fresh request instead of repeating the one that was stopped.

What success looks like

  • You have exactly one copy of the PDF result you wanted, under Artifacts from this run or in your chosen folder.

If it still fails

  • If the action keeps stopping without you stopping it, select Copy error details and send them to the person who manages SMTO.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • The PDF operation was cancelled during processing, or the Gateway refused it because its execution ID was already running or finished within the last five minutes.

What this means

  • The File layer observed cancellation/timeout, or PDF admission found the execution ID already active or retained as completed/cancelled. PDF parsing and OCR remain local bounded operations on the selected Gateway. Outputs are separate create-only files/artifacts; diagnostic rendering adds no reads, credential recovery, model calls or automatic retries.

Why this can happen

  • The File layer observed cancellation/timeout, or PDF admission found the execution ID already active or retained as completed/cancelled.

How to diagnose it

  • Distinguish cancellation, deadline and duplicate admission from the original receipt and publication state.

How to fix it

  • Check whether the run was cancelled (cancel fences the execution_id for 5 minutes) or whether PdfService.execute found the same execution_id active or recently finished. Inspect the run's artifact workspace and any explicit output_path for output from the original request; issue a new request with a new execution identity only if no output exists. Do not replay the same execution_id.
  • Inspect the original operation and existing artifacts; do not replay a retained identity.

Retry and execution caution

  • The operation was cancelled. Inspect existing artifacts before choosing a new operation.

How to verify the fix

  • The original worker and output lifecycle settle before separately authorized new work.

What not to do

  • Never automatically replay uncertain writes or execute embedded document content.

Technical notes

  • PDF parsing and OCR remain local bounded operations on the selected Gateway. Outputs are separate create-only files/artifacts; diagnostic rendering adds no reads, credential recovery, model calls or automatic retries.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
